in_scope: official decisions, votes, resolutions, waivers, appeals, credentials, discipline, penalties, compliance, and enforcement records authorized by the charter and bylaws
objectives: Map every rule-granted decision and enforcement power to the responsible body or officer
Acquire public cases, rulings, waivers, appeals, challenges, penalties, and resolutions
Record facts, allegations, defenses, findings, votes, dispositions, and later reversals separately
Trace counsel, staff, vendors, and outside institutional ties
out_of_scope: private disciplinary files not officially released
preferred_sources: official DNC decisions, resolutions, minutes, proceedings, rules, waivers, and appeals
court and government records where applicable
